h1: What changes the price of cannabis in Pattaya
intro: Thai law treats a published cannabis price as advertising, so no number appears on this site. What can be explained is why one gram costs more than another, and what you can look at in the shop to tell the difference. Labs Cannabis is at 32 Pattaya 13 Alley in South Pattaya; flower is handed over in the shop, to adults aged 20 or older who hold a prescription issued in Thailand.

sections.h2: What you can judge with your own eyes
sections.body: Ask to see and smell what is in the jar before you decide. Density, the smell after the jar is opened and the neatness of the trim tell you more than any label. Flower that has been sitting for months is drier and crumbles between the fingers; a slow cure and hand trimming show up immediately. Staff will open several jars and explain how each batch was grown.

sections.h2: Why the shop will not put a figure on this page
sections.body: Since June 2025 cannabis flower has been a controlled herb, and advertising it — the price included — is what gets a dispensary suspended. So there is no list here, no basket and no payment. What is in the shop today is a question for a person: ask on WhatsApp +66 66 080 6784 before you cross town.

Nothing about price changes who may buy: adults aged 20 or older, holding a prescription issued in Thailand, in person at the counter. A prescription covers a supply of no more than 30 days, and the legal guide on this site sets out the rest of the notices.

faq.q: Why is there no price on this page?
faq.a: A published cannabis price counts as advertising under Thai law, and the penalty lands on the shop's licence. The page explains what changes the price instead.
Identification that shows you are 20 or older and a prescription issued in Thailand. Both are checked at the counter before anything is handed over.

closing: Ask on WhatsApp +66 66 080 6784 what is in the shop today, or open Google Maps and come to 32 Pattaya 13 Alley. Adults 20+ with a prescription issued in Thailand.
